prompt_en: A natural photographic costume portrait of a fictional model, explicitly an adult woman, wearing a complete historical uniform ensemble in an intricately staged single scene. Use the supplied portrait as the face and bob-hair reference, retaining the soft oval face, dark almond-shaped eyes, delicate nose, natural lips, and dark chin-length bob with wispy center-parted fringe. She stands in a quiet station baggage hall beside a low wooden costume trunk, just finishing a small adjustment at her waist. Her Zouave costume consists of a short open navy wool jacket with curved scarlet braid edging, a fitted navy waistcoat beneath it, a broad red woven sash wrapped around her waist, and very full scarlet trousers gathered toward the ankles. The jacket ends above the sash, the visible waistcoat sits within the jacket opening, and the sash separates the short upper layers from the ballooning trousers. White canvas gaiters enclose the lower trouser ends above dark leather shoes. Her two voluminous trouser legs bulge independently around her thighs; gathered trouser cuffs form narrow puckered scarlet rings just above both white gaiter edges. A low red felt fez with a dark tassel rests above her visible bob. Her right fingertips tuck a short sash tail into the waist wrap while her left hand rests loosely at her side; both feet settle flat on the stone floor with a small gap between them. Long afternoon window light rakes across the wool nap, raised braid, sash folds, and cotton gaiters, with cooler hall light filling her face. The brass corners and pale tissue lining of the open trunk echo the warm light. She glances toward the camera with quiet confidence and a softly relaxed mouth. A full-length, nearly frontal frame includes her head, hands, waist, ankles, and shoes; the clothing junctions and generous trouser volume remain clearly readable against the subdued hall.
